sources.citation: Edenhofer et al. (2024), A parsec-scale Galactic 3D dust map out to 1.25 kpc, dataset v1.0.2, DOI 10.5281/zenodo.10658339

distance.method: Geometric distance from the Sun to the centre (-355, -255, -155) pc of the selected heliocentric Galactic Cartesian crop; this locates the display volume, not a single astronomical object.

classification.name: Bounded Galactic dust reconstruction
classification.basis: A 96 x 96 x 96 voxel crop of the published posterior-mean dust-extinction reconstruction, already interpolated by the authors onto a 2 pc heliocentric Galactic Cartesian grid. It is not a named cloud, photographic brightness, or directly measured mass density.
